shots.picture: Peter's face fills the frame, facing forward, mouth closed, eyes wide, with small orange flames resting on his short curly grey-brown hair.
shots.action: Peter's mouth opens wide and closes repeatedly as he speaks, his jaw moving up and down, while the small orange flames on his hair flicker and dance.

shots.picture: Peter stands on the left facing right, mouth open, with small orange flames on his hair; a Jerusalem Crowd Member stands on the right facing left, listening.
shots.action: Peter continues to speak, his mouth opening and closing rhythmically, while the small orange flames on his hair flicker gently.
